subject: dsa
title: Merge K Sorted Lists
summary: Merge k sorted lists by repeatedly taking the smallest head.
problem: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list. Repeatedly take the smallest current head, using a min-heap of the k heads to pick it in log k time. Here the lists are [1,4], [2,6], and [3,5].

steps.caption: Merge 3 sorted lists [1,4], [2,6], [3,5]. Repeatedly take the smallest head using a min-heap.
The three heads are 1, 2, 3. The smallest is 1, so output it first.
Heads advance. The next smallest heads are 2 then 3, so they come out next.
The remaining heads 4, 5, 6 follow in order.
